## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), which means I agree to the
      Contributor Licence Agreement in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The contribution is my own work and I have the right to submit it
- [ ] Comments and identifiers are in English; user-facing text goes through
      the localisation keys
- [ ] New or changed strings exist in **both** locales
- [ ] A change to `README.md` is mirrored in `README.ru.md`
- [ ] Checked against the mock data (`MOCK=1`) in both languages and themes
